content_data:
# Get user information Use this endpoint to obtain information about users who are authorized to access the developer App. ## Comparing v1.2 and v1.3 The following table outlines the differences between v1.2 and v1.3 endpoints. ```xtable |Changes{30%}|v1.2{35%}|v1.3{35%}| |---|---|---| |Endpoint path|/v1.2/user/info/|/v1.3/user/info/| |Response parameter name and data type |`id`: number| `core_user_id` : string| |New response parameter| /|`avatar_url`| ``` ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/user/info/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738373164380162).| ``` ### Example ``` xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --get -H "Access-Token:xxx" \ https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/user/info/ (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |code|number|Return code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097)| |message |string|Return message. For details, see [Appendix-Return message](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097)| |data|object|Returned data. | #|display_name |string| User's username.| #|email |string| User's E-mail.

Note: E-mails are data-masked.| #|core_user_id|string|The TikTok for Business user ID.| #|create_time|timestamp| User's creation time.| #| avatar_url | string | The URL of the user's avatar.| |request_id |string|The log id of a request, which uniquely identifies the request.| ``` ### Example ``` xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "message": "OK", "code": 0, "data": { "display_name": "Jane Doe", "id": 75960823000, "email": "j***e@example.org", "create_time":1561518952 }, "request_id": "2020051106295001023125009013359" } (/code) ```
